<h1 class="gutter-top" style="-ms-word-wrap: break-word; word-wrap: break-word;">
  What do new awardees need to better understand the SD Opportunity Scholarship?
</h1>





<div id="ctl00_ctl00_cpContent_cpContent_divBody" class="gutter-top break-word ckeShim clearfix"><h2><span style="color: #3B4F6B"><strong>Congratulations on being awarded the South Dakota Opportunity Scholar</strong></span><span style="color: #3B4F6B"><strong>ship</strong></span></h2>

<h3>Please read through all of this information to find out more information about the scholarship requirements and the funding amounts. </h3>

<h2><span style="color: #3B4F6B"><strong>Amount of Scholarship</strong></span></h2>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" width="303">
	<tbody>
		<tr height="28">
			<td height="28" style="text-align: center" width="126">

			</td>

			</td>
		</tr>
		<tr height="28">
			<td height="28" style="text-align: center">
			<h3>$1,500.00</h3>
			</td>
			<td style="text-align: center">
			<h3>First Year </h3>
			</td>
		</tr>
		<tr height="28">

			</td>

			</td>
		</tr>
		<tr height="28">

<h3> </h3>

<h2><span style="color: #3B4F6B"><strong>Continuing Eligibility</strong></span></h2>

<h3 align="justify">Once a student has been awarded, they will not need to complete another application.  However, students must meet the continued eligibility requirements each semester.  They include the following:</h3>

<ul>
	<li>
	<h3 align="justify">Recipients must maintain a cumulative 3.0 grade point average on a 4.0 scale.</h3>
	</li>
	<li>
	<h3 align="justify">Recipients must attempt and complete enough earned credit hours of instruction to meet the credit hour threshold for the forthcoming year (30 credit hours for the 3rd and 4th term funding, 60 credit hours for 5th and 6th term funding, and 90 credit hours for 7th and 8th term funding). Recipients failing to attempt or meet their respective credit hour benchmark in a given year become <em><u>permanently ineligible</u></em> in the scholarship program.</h3>
	</li>
	<li>
	<h3 align="justify">Any recipient who loses eligibility because the student's cumulative grade point average falls below 3.0 <em><u>may reestablish eligibility </u></em>by raising the cumulative grade point average to 3.0 or greater and then fill out the <a href="https://tdx.sdbor.edu/TDClient/33/Portal/Requests/ServiceDet?ID=131"><span style="color: #0000FF">eligibility reinstatement form</span></a>.</h3>
	</li>
	<li>
	<h3 align="justify">Each semester the South Dakota Board of Regents monitors recipient continuing eligibility in the Opportunity Scholarship program and notifies the campus of any irregularities and uploads data into a database maintained by the Board of Regents called Scholarship Manager.</h3>
	</li>
</ul>

<h3 align="justify">This data is carefully monitored at both the institutional and system level to ensure that all students have met the continuing eligibility requirements specified in legislative statute that governs the scholarship program. For instance, campus personnel review credit hours attempted at the start of each semester and notify those students who are at risk of not meeting their respective credit hour threshold for the forthcoming year. Those students who fail to complete enough credit hours are not included in an institution's term funding request, and subsequently become <em><u>permanently ineligible</u></em> for further funding. As a function of South Dakota Codified Law, Administrative Rules have been developed to manage recipient continued eligibility across four areas including instances when a:</h3>

<ol>
	<li>
	<h3>Recipient failed to meet the <a href="http://sdlegislature.gov/Rules/DisplayRule.aspx?Rule=24:40:13:05"><span style="color: #6E949E">credit hour threshold</span></a> requirement.</h3>
	</li>
	<li>
	<h3>Recipient is no longer actively enrolled in the program resulting from <a href="http://sdlegislature.gov/Rules/DisplayRule.aspx?Rule=24:40:13:06"><span style="color: #6E949E">persistence issues</span></a> (stop-out without executive director exemption), transfer outside the state, and withdrawal from an institution in South Dakota.</h3>
	</li>
	<li>
	<h3>Recipient fell below the <a href="http://sdlegislature.gov/Rules/DisplayRule.aspx?Rule=24:40:13:07"><span style="color: #6E949E">3.0 cumulative grade point average</span></a><span style="color: #6E949E">.</span></h3>
	</li>
</ol>

<h2><span style="color: #3B4F6B"><strong>Courses Graded S/U Only</strong></span></h2>

<h3 align="justify">In the past, institutions were required to obtain an exemption from courses that awarded Satisfactory/Unsatisfactory (S/U) or Pass/Fail grades. Under the new statute, any credit hours with an assigned grade (excludes "W" or "I") can be counted as earned credit.</h3>

<h2 align="justify"><span style="color: #1A2133"></span><span style="color: #3B4F6B"><strong>Treatment of Special Enrollment</strong></span><span style="color: #3B4F6B"><strong>s</strong></span></h2>

<h3 align="justify">The <a href="https://sdos.sdbor.edu/require/Pages/Administrative-Rules.aspx"><span style="color: #6E949E">Administrative Rules</span></a> for the Opportunity Scholarship program also outline the impact that special enrollments have on a recipient's continuing eligibility. The following conditions for purpose of eligibility apply to special enrollments:</h3>

<ol>
	<li>
	<h3><a href="http://sdlegislature.gov/Rules/DisplayRule.aspx?Rule=24:40:13:10"><span style="color: #6E949E">Summer and Interim Sessions.</span></a></h3>
	</li>
	<li>
	<h3><a href="http://sdlegislature.gov/Rules/DisplayRule.aspx?Rule=24:40:13:10"><span style="color: #6E949E">Repeated Courses.</span></a></h3>
	</li>
	<li>
	<h3><a href="http://sdlegislature.gov/Rules/DisplayRule.aspx?Rule=24:40:13:10"><span style="color: #6E949E">Internships and Similar External Placement.</span></a></h3>
	</li>
</ol>

<h2><strong><span style="color: #3B4F6B">Requesting an Exemption</span></strong></h2>

<h3>State statue grants the Executive Director of the Board of Regents the authority to grant exemptions to continuous enrollment requirements when good cause is shown. As a result, when a situation arises that hinders a student from meeting the eligibility requirements for the South Dakota Opportunity Scholarship, he/she has the opportunity to request an exemption waiver from the Executive Director. </h3>

<h3>The administrative rules that govern the Opportunity Scholarship program provides authority to the Board of Regents to grant waivers to a limited number of continuous eligibility criteria including the Credit Hour Thresholds and Persistence Requirements<span style="color: #6E949E">.</span>   As a result, when a situation arises that hinders a student from meeting the continuing eligibility requirements for the program, he/she has the opportunity to request an exemption waiver from the Executive Director.  To this date, waivers have been granted based on five specific rationales including:</h3>

<ol>
	<li>
	<h3>Situations where a medical hardship has hindered a student's progress;</h3>
	</li>
	<li>
	<h3>Student participation in an approved exchange program through their institution;</h3>
	</li>
	<li>
	<h3>Conflict with program of study requirements that influence student credit hours;</h3>
	</li>
	<li>
	<h3>Participation in an institution approved internship or cooperative education program; and/or,</h3>
	</li>
	<li>
	<h3>Military deferral for National Guard or military service.</h3>
	</li>
</ol>

<h3>While waivers are routinely granted for the issues outline above, the Legislature has not granted a Participating Institution or the Board of Regents with the authority to grant waivers for other requirements established in the state statute or administrative rules.  These include:</h3>

<ol>
	<li>
	<h3>Failure to meet all of the initial eligibility requirements (<a href="http://legis.state.sd.us/statutes/DisplayStatute.aspx?Type=Statute&Statute=13-55-31"><span style="color: #6E949E">13-55-31</span></a><span style="color: #6E949E"> & </span><a href="http://legis.state.sd.us/statutes/DisplayStatute.aspx?Type=Statute&Statute=13-55-31.1"><span style="color: #6E949E">13-55-31.1</span></a>);</h3>
	</li>
</ol>

<ul style="margin-left: 40px">
	<li type="square">
	<h3>Be a resident of South Dakota at the time of graduation from high school;</h3>
	</li>
	<li type="square">
	<h3>Have a composite score of 24 or higher on the ACT;</h3>
	</li>
	<li type="square">
	<h3>Meet the high school course requirements for graduation, with a cumulative average grade of “B” (3.0  on a 4.0 scale), and a C or higher in all required courses;</h3>
	</li>
	<li type="square">
	<h3>Attend a participating post-secondary institution within South Dakota;</h3>
	</li>
	<li type="square">
	<h3>Enter into the program within five years of graduation</h3>
	</li>
</ul>

<ol start="2">
	<li>
	<h3>Failure to meet the established application deadlines <span style="color: #6E949E">(</span><a href="http://legis.state.sd.us/rules/DisplayRule.aspx?Rule=24:40:13:12"><span style="color: #6E949E">24:40:13:12</span></a><span style="color: #6E949E">, </span><a href="http://legis.state.sd.us/rules/DisplayRule.aspx?Rule=24:40:13:14"><span style="color: #6E949E">24:40:13:14</span></a><span style="color: #6E949E">);</span></h3>
	</li>
	<li>
	<h3>Failure to meet the 3.0 GPA requirements for continuous eligibility criteria <span style="color: #6E949E">(</span><a href="http://legis.state.sd.us/statutes/DisplayStatute.aspx?Type=Statute&Statute=13-55-34"><span style="color: #6E949E">13-55-34</span></a><span style="color: #6E949E">)</span>; and/or</h3>
	</li>
	<li>
	<h3>Early payment of scholarship awards outside the requirements set forth in <a href="http://legis.state.sd.us/statutes/DisplayStatute.aspx?Type=Statute&Statute=13-55-33"><span style="color: #6E949E">13-55-33</span></a><span style="color: #6E949E"> or </span><a href="http://legis.state.sd.us/rules/DisplayRule.aspx?Rule=24:40:13:20"><span style="color: #6E949E">24:40:13:20</span></a>.</h3>
	</li>
</ol>

<h4>To request an exemption, please complete the <a href="https://tdx.sdbor.edu/TDClient/33/Portal/Requests/ServiceDet?ID=70"><span style="color: #6E949E">Exemption Request (South Dakota Opportunity Scholarship)</span></a> form. </h4>

<h4>For more information, select <u><a href="https://tdx.sdbor.edu/TDClient/33/Portal/KB/?CategoryID=43"><span style="color: #775477"></span></a><a href="https://tdx.sdbor.edu/TDClient/33/Portal/KB/?CategoryID=43"><span style="color: #775477">VIEW ALL SDOS SCHOLARSHIP ARTICLES</span></a></u><a href="https://tdx.sdbor.edu/TDClient/33/Portal/KB/?CategoryID=43"><u><span style="color: #775477">.</span></u></a></h4>

<p>For additional information not found, <strong><a href="https://tdx.sdbor.edu/TDClient/33/Portal/Requests/TicketRequests/NewForm?ID=NszRCEJBab0_&RequestorType=Service"><span style="color: #6E949E">Contact Us</span></a><span style="color: #6E949E">.</span></strong></p></div>

          const queryParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
          let showChatbot = true;
          if (queryParams.has('nobot')) {
            const nobotFlag = queryParams.get('nobot');
            if (nobotFlag === '1' || nobotFlag === 'true') {
              showChatbot = false;

          if(showChatbot) {

        window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {

          // Only accept events that come from the same origin
          if (event.origin != window.location.origin) {
            return;
          }

          switch (event.data.type) {

            case "authenticate-using-popup":
              handleAuthenticateUsingPopup(event.data.payload);
              break;

            case "authenticated-successfully":
              handleAuthenticatedSuccessfully(event.data.payload);
              break;

            default:
              break;
          }

        });

        function handleAuthenticateUsingPopup(payload) {
          let loginUrl = '/TDClient/33/Portal/Login.aspx';

          if (payload.successCallbackUrl) {
            loginUrl += '?SuccessCallbackUrl=' + payload.successCallbackUrl;
          }

          window.open(loginUrl, "_blank", "popup=1");
        }

        function handleAuthenticatedSuccessfully() {
          event.source.close();
          window.location.href = window.location.href;
        }
